decisions.evaluation: Held-out old low/high tyres only. No unseen-mid, unseen-video, three-class-generalisation or safety claim.
decisions.geometry: New polygon-derived points are weak training targets with weight 0.25; validation/test use only existing human points.
decisions.identity: All three original mid tyres and all new frames are training-only; unknown exact mapping is not invented.
decisions.masks: SegFormer ignores contradictory pixels. YOLO training tyre = raw tyre OR raw tread; tread unchanged. Derived policy, not human correction.
